abilities.name: Explosive Puppet

cooldownModifiers.source: C4: It's Not Just Any Doll...

_curatorNotes: C4 (It's Not Just Any Doll...) also adds 1 additional charge (total 2 at C4+). chargeModifiers entry and E key in frames deferred to reviewer: E value would be 33 (InitAbilSlice default — gcsim comment labels AnimationLength as '// E -> E (C1 only)', likely meaning C4+). Mirrors Sucrose C1 precedent for constellation-gated charges.

Hold E variant: all frames += hold parameter (variable), Baron Bunny spawnsAt = 45+hold, cooldownStartDelay = 5+hold. Variable offset not modeled in variants[]. Reviewer to decide if a variant entry is warranted.
Baron Bunny duration: b.Duration=484 frames / 60 = 8.067s, rounded to 8.1. spawnsAt=45 is the bunnyLand constant for tap E (hold=0). Hold E places bunny at 45+hold frames.
C4 CD reduction: gcsim codes SetCDWithDelay(ActionSkill, 720, ...) at C4+ vs 900 frames base. 720/60=12s, modeled as -20% cooldownModifier. Reviewer to verify against in-game description.
abilities.description:
The ever-reliable Baron Bunny takes the stage.

Baron Bunny
·Continuously taunts the enemy, drawing their fire.
·Baron Bunny's HP scales with Amber's Max HP.
·When destroyed or when its timer expires, Baron Bunny explodes, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Hold
Adjusts the throwing direction of Baron Bunny.
The longer the button is held, the further the throw.

abilities.name: Fiery Rain
_curatorNotes: N and E frames omitted: burstFrames[ActionAttack] and burstFrames[ActionSkill] are InitAbilSlice(111) defaults (not explicitly assigned in burst.go). Comment says '// Q -> N1/E' at the InitAbilSlice call — reviewer to verify whether 111 is a meaningful cancel for N or E.

Fiery Rain modeled as summon (duration 2s, spawnsAt 72). Duration sourced from burst loop bounds (three loops all capping at i<=120, i.e. 120 frames = 2s at 60fps); no explicit `duration :=` constant in burst.go. burstStart=72 used as spawnsAt per recipe convention. Reviewer to confirm summon modeling is appropriate for a continuous arrow barrage rather than a persistent entity.
abilities.description: Fires off a shower of arrows, dealing continuous AoE Pyro DMG.

passives.name: Every Arrow Finds Its Target
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim snapshots the buff on Q cast and applies it to Fiery Rain ticks. The +10% CR semantically applies only to Fiery Rain hits, but authoring as a self critRate buff during the burst duration is the closest fit — sub-ability filter for 'Fiery Rain only' is a G dependency.
AoE widening (30% on Fiery Rain AoE) not modeled — no schema field for AoE radius modifiers.
passives.description: Increases the CRIT Rate of Fiery Rain by 10% and widens its AoE by 30%.
